summary: Answer strict exact RFI/Submittal date-role questions from existing local project evidence.
decision_refs: The active objective prioritizes efficiency and accuracy across RFI, Submittal and Email
Existing date-role grounding already provides the required atomic and workflow-scoped semantics
The complete workflow index can bound primary sources without a new index or provider call
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency and accuracy improvements across existing RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: Only strict English questions for one exact workflow identity and one supported explicit date role use the shortcut.
Missing, plural, comparison and interpretive date questions remain on ordinary grounded Q&A.
Quoted history, vision narration, conflicting dates, more than 32 primary files and more than 512 candidate passages fail closed.
The shortcut does not calculate deadlines, order events, infer current state or select contractual authority.
